label: A3 accessible occurrence uniqueness transports possible conditioning
paraphrase: For unrestricted bearer, time, state, world and condition carriers: IF, among the occurrences that occur at some world accessible from w, only the selected occurrence carries the selected state-pair transition, and some occurrence with that transition is possibly conditioned at w, THEN the selected occurrence itself is possibly conditioned at w. Occurrences with the same transition that occur at no accessible world are permitted. Conditional analyst transport with attribution deferred; uniqueness and the matching conditioning are explicit hypotheses, not established. The condition relation remains primitive and gives no concrete bearer, temporal presence or actuality.
